:::note[このページについて]
[s1000d-verify-mcp](/s1000d-stack/ja/mcp/verify-mcp/) 0.11.0 の `tools/list` の応答から生成したページです。設定のしかたと応答の読み方は、s1000d-verify-mcp のページにあります。
:::

## 概要

参照を 5 種類集め、参照先の有無を理由付き（`not-found` / `no-entity-declaration` / `file-not-found` / `no-such-id` / `no-csdb`）で返します。仕様書の章への `dmRef`（モデル識別コード `S1000D`）は参照切れではないので別枠にします

## `tools/list` が返す説明

LLM が受け取る説明の原文（英語）です。

> List the references of one document and whether each target exists: dmRef (all contexts: brexDmRef, applicCrossRefTableRef, pmEntry, body), pmRef, ICN (graphic/@infoEntityIdent via the DOCTYPE ENTITY declaration to a file), internalRef (ids in the same document) and applicRefId (applic ids or referencedApplicGroupRef/applicRef). Unresolved references carry a reason (not-found, no-entity-declaration, file-not-found, no-such-id, no-csdb). dmRef to modelIdentCode "S1000D" point to the specification itself and are listed separately.

## 引数

`inputSchema` の内容です。入れ子の引数は `親.子`、配列の要素は `親[].子` と書いています。説明は原文（英語）です。

| 名前 | 型 | 必須 | 値の制約 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` |  |  | File path of the data module (or PM) to check. |
| `xml` | `string` |  |  | The document as an XML string (alternative to path; max 5 MB). |
| `csdbDirs` | `array<string>` |  |  | CSDB folders to search for referenced data modules, publication modules, ICN files and BREX (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file; BREX is also searched under S1000D_SPEC_DIR). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes. |
| `kinds` | `array<string>` |  |  | Reference kinds to report (default: all). |
| `includeResolved` | `boolean` |  | 既定値 `false` | Also list resolved references with the file they resolve to (default false; counts are always returned). |
| `maxItems` | `number` |  | 既定値 `200` | Cap on listed references (default 200). |
